Dokany optional runtime dependency
==================================

Smart Explorer can install the unmodified official Dokany x64 runtime MSI as
an optional system-wide prerequisite for Windows remote-drive hosting. The
official driver and system DLL are not overwritten by the private correction.

Version: 2.3.1.1000 (API 231)
Upstream project: https://github.com/dokan-dev/dokany
Exact source tag: https://github.com/dokan-dev/dokany/tree/v2.3.1.1000
Source archive: https://github.com/dokan-dev/dokany/archive/refs/tags/v2.3.1.1000.tar.gz
Official binary release: https://github.com/dokan-dev/dokany/releases/tag/v2.3.1.1000

According to the tagged upstream README, dokan2.dll, dokan2.sys, the network
and FUSE libraries, and the installer are licensed under GNU LGPL v3; the
Dokan control program and samples are licensed under the MIT License. Copies
of GNU GPL v3, GNU LGPL v3, and the upstream MIT notice accompany this notice.

Dokany is not part of Smart Explorer and is not removed by the Smart Explorer
uninstaller because it is a shared machine-wide runtime that other programs
may use.

Private user-mode correction
----------------------------
Smart Explorer also distributes a modified x64 user-mode DLL based on commit
f1d5de68ff459af94e309cfdd171e4b8ca2af4dd. The correction normalizes batching options
before driver startup, fixes a mask-to-BOOLEAN truncation, and adds a private
completed-batch counter for verification. It makes no driver/protocol change.
This modified library remains licensed under GNU LGPL version 3.

The application embeds the verified DLL and its corresponding-source.zip and
loads a hash-addressed private copy. The official installed DLL remains the
non-batched compatibility fallback. Portable and auto-updated applications
extract this notice, the license texts and corresponding-source.zip next to
that private runtime before loading it.

Full Smart Explorer source, private-library patch, build recipe, recombination
instructions and approved dependency bytes are available in the repository:
https://github.com/b1ue-man/smart-explorer
Use the source tag matching the installed Smart Explorer version. In that
source tree see native/dokany-private/README.md and
native/assets/dokany-private/corresponding-source.zip. The complete application
source and supplied preparation/build materials allow modification and
recombination with a modified library; byte pinning is an integrity check, not
a restriction on modifying or rebuilding the supplied source.
